m.s: Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut {potato} into chunks and toss with oil, salt and chopped {rosemary} on a lined tray. Roast for 35 to 40 minutes, turning halfway, until golden.
Slice {chk_breast} in half horizontally, then flatten slightly between two sheets of baking paper so they're an even thickness. Season with salt and pepper.
Pick the leaves from {sage} and lay one on each piece, then wrap each one in a slice of prosciutto ({prosciutto} in all). Lightly dust the outside in {flour} and shake off the excess.

Heat a drizzle of oil and {butter*0.3} in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken prosciutto side down first for 3 minutes a side until golden and cooked through (75°C in the thickest part). Set aside.
Turn the heat down to medium. Add the rest of the butter, the juice of {lemon} and {stockpowder} dissolved in ¼ cup hot water per 2 serves. Bubble for 1 minute, scraping up the golden bits.
Wilt {spinach} in the pan for 1 minute. Serve the chicken on the spinach with the sauce spooned over and the potatoes alongside.

l: Chicken and potatoes together, sauce poured over. Reheat in the oven. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: GF flour for dusting (or skip it) and check the stock powder. Cook the GF ones first.
